entries.answer: pr-axis dev is a design, build, and automate studio. The site is pr-axisdev.com. Three services: Design, Build, Automate. Start with what you need, one thing is enough.
entries.title: What is pr-axis dev

entries.answer: Ask Marcus is pr-axis dev's AI assistant. It answers questions and gives rough estimates. For anything else, the inquiry form reaches the team.
entries.title: Who is Ask Marcus

entries.answer: Send an inquiry through the form on pr-axisdev.com. It asks for your name, email, what you need (you can pick the services, or pick Not sure yet), and a message. No account, no signup.
entries.title: How to start
